name: @dsh-external/dsh-petdex-pet
description: Petdex pet in the DSH web GUI: floating bottom-right, draggable, sprite-animated by agent activity, with a live settings page (size / enable / switch / delete / gallery search + previews / install-by-code) and hover interactions. Ships with 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets (Gon, Killua, Kurapika, Leorio).
